description: Public question sets of the MoE vs dense measurement: R (20) and H (29) and F (10) over the Rogers Commission report on the Challenger accident (Volume 1 and Volume 2 Appendix F), N (31) and D (8) over 14 official reports published 2026-10-02 to 2026-11-06. 'sample' is the corpus key (challenger, berichte26). 'kind': single, number, multi, trap, reason-1..3. 'facts': every inner list is one key fact, satisfied when the answer contains any of its spellings (lower-case, whitespace-insensitive substring); trap rows without facts: the right answer says the information is not in the documents; trap rows with facts: the right answer names the error and gives these facts. Personal names are replaced by roles (except the author of Appendix F). Withheld for privacy: D5, D7, D9, N13, N21, N22, N23, N27, N34, N38.
format_hint: Formatting: short paragraphs; a list for steps; a Markdown table when comparing several items across several attributes.

questions.question: What was the air temperature at the launch of Challenger, and how much colder was that than at any previous launch?
How many seconds after liftoff did the flight end, and how many seconds after launch did the range safety officer destroy the boosters?
At what point in the flight (in seconds) did the first flame appear on the right Solid Rocket Booster, and at about how many degrees around the booster circumference?
Mit welcher Machzahl und in welcher Höhe flog die Challenger, als sie vom Feuerball eingehüllt wurde?
How many times was the launch of mission 51-L postponed and how many times was it scrubbed, counted from which planned launch date in January 1986?
Who were the two payload specialists added to the 51-L crew (describe each by occupation), and which company did one of them represent?
How many rubber O-rings seal each field joint, and what diameter do they have?
Below what O-ring temperature did Thiokol (its Vice President, Engineering) recommend not to fly STS 51-L, and how did that temperature compare with previous flights?
Which Thiokol official was asked by Thiokol's Senior Vice President for Wasatch Operations to take off his engineering hat and put on his management hat during the Thiokol caucus? Give his position.
According to Feynman, which group gave the very low estimate of the Shuttle failure probability, about 1 in 100,000?
If the failure probability were really 1 in 100,000, how long could one launch a Shuttle every day before expecting to lose one, according to Feynman?
Out of how many rocket flights did how many fail according to the range safety officer's study cited by Feynman, and which safety panel did that officer chair?
Wie viele Sekunden Betriebszeit hatten die Haupttriebwerke laut Feynman insgesamt, und wie oft sind sie in dieser Zeit ernsthaft ausgefallen?
What must take precedence over public relations according to the closing sentence of Feynman's appendix, and why?
Which civilian crew member does Feynman name at the end of his appendix as a person of great courage? Give her role on the mission.
By how many million dollars was the Orbiter logistics (spare parts) funding cut in 1985, and what was the funding requirement it was cut from?
How much did the Challenger orbiter cost to build?
Wie viele Menschen verfolgten den Start der Challenger im Fernsehen?
What did Feynman demonstrate with a piece of O-ring rubber and a glass of ice water at the hearing?
What was the price of the TDRS-B satellite that was lost on Challenger?

In October 1985, what was the logistics funding requirement for the Orbiter program, by how much was it cut, and how much did that leave? And when the spare-parts stockage for 12 flights a year should have been complete, how many of the required items had actually been delivered?

Compare the service-life figures for the Space Shuttle Main Engine turbopumps given in Chapter IX of the Commission report with those in Feynman's Appendix F. Give the limits Chapter IX states for the low-pressure fuel and oxidizer pumps, the high-pressure oxidizer pump and the equivalent life of most engine components, and Feynman's replacement intervals for the two high-pressure turbopumps together with the original design lifetime he cites.

In the 1971 Rockwell data on ejection systems quoted in Chapter IX, which system was heavier than the open ejection seat but cheaper to develop? Give the weights and development costs of both, the weight of the separable crew compartment, and the more recent estimate of how much an escape module could add to the Orbiter's weight.
Challenger flew nine missions before 51-L. According to the O-ring anomaly table in Chapter VI (Figure 2), how many and which of those nine Challenger flights showed no O-ring anomaly at all?

According to the Chapter IX table of landing-site changes, which missions scheduled to land at Kennedy had to land at Edwards instead, how many wave-offs did each have, which mission in that table was not a Kennedy diversion and where did it land, and how many flights had been launched with plans to land in Florida?
Appendix C lists the earlier field joints on which the circumferential alignment tool had been used before 51-L. How many and which of those joints did not experience O-ring damage?

In the Chapter VI table of O-ring anomalies (Figure 2), how many and which Shuttle flights launched with a joint temperature of 75°F or higher showed no O-ring anomaly, and for which flight in that temperature range can the table not say?

Put these events in chronological order and date each: the field joint's classification as Criticality 1R, the Thiokol engineer's 'simplex' retention rationale, the revised Critical Items List entry reclassifying the joint as Criticality 1, the Level I approval of the Criticality 1 waiver, and the launch of STS-6.

Reconstruct the times (EST) of the evening of January 27, 1986: when did the first Thiokol/NASA teleconference begin, for when was the second one planned and when did it actually begin, when was it recessed for the Thiokol caucus and how long did the caucus last, when was the teleconference terminated, and when was the NASA Space Transportation System Program Manager at Johnson called?

Three different 'margins' for O-ring erosion are quoted in the report: the one in Thiokol's final management agreement on the night of January 27, the one the Solid Rocket Booster project manager at Marshall gave the Commission based on STS-2, and the one the Commission's executive director derived from the Flight Readiness Review figures. Give each margin and the erosion depths it rests on.

The report states the link between temperature and O-ring thermal distress twice, once in the Chapter IV findings and once in Chapter VI. Give both versions: which temperature is meant, the thresholds, and the counts of flights with and without distress.

How much rain fell on 51-L while it stood on the launch pad, and how much would have been normal? The report gives two different figures for how many days 51-L was exposed on the pad: give both. How much water had been found in an STS-9 clevis well after less rain?

For the left nozzle joint of STS 51-B, how deep did the primary and the secondary O-ring erode, what maximum erosion had been predicted (for the primary in the former and the revised model, and for the secondary), and what erosion would a field joint have suffered at the same ratio of actual to projected erosion?
What share of the External Tank, of the Orbiter and of the TDRS/IUS payload package was recovered after the accident, and in about how much water were the main engines and the crew module found?

Two problems from mission 61-C did not reach the 51-L Flight Readiness Review. Give the dates of that review, of 61-C's landing (and where it landed), of the completion of the 61-C booster inspection, and of when the Johnson brake subsystem manager first received the brake information and when he learned its extent. At what brake energy did the 61-C damage occur, compared with the energy available before the first stator fails under normal braking?
Why did a Marshall engineer sign the January 1978 and January 1979 memoranda to his superior that called the Thiokol joint design unacceptable?
facts: chief of the solid rocket motor branch
head of the solid rocket motor branch
chief of the solid rocket motor

questions.question: Thiokol's June 1985 O-ring resiliency bench test showed that at 50°F the O-ring lost contact with the metal for 2.4 seconds. What did the same test show at 75°F and at 100°F?
Why did the president of Rockwell's Space Transportation Systems Division tell the 9:00 a.m. Mission Management Team meeting at Kennedy on January 28 that Rockwell would not approve the launch?

After the cold-weather flight 51-C in January 1985, the Solid Rocket Booster project manager at Marshall placed a launch constraint on the Solid Rocket Booster. Which flights flew under waivers of that constraint before 51-L, and how many were there?

How many people in total took part in NASA's own investigation of the accident (NASA employees, other government agencies and contractors together), and how many pages of transcript did the Commission's work generate in total (interviews and panel sessions plus hearings)? What were the two computer data bases the Commission built and what did each contain, and what page counts do Appendices A and B give for the document collection?

Chapter III's narrative of the 51-L ascent mentions only part of the main-engine throttling. Give every main-engine throttle command with its mission elapsed time to the millisecond as listed in the Chapter III table of major events, compute how long the engines stayed throttled back from the first throttle-down command until they were commanded back up to their highest setting, and state the (different) times that Chapter II's flight timeline gives for the two throttle-down steps.

Which live television transmissions from orbit were planned for 51-L: how many, on which flight days and during which activities? How many of the teacher's lessons were to be telecast live, and which NASA scheduling practice contradicts the rumor of a planned live hookup with the crew during the President's State of the Union Message?
Which members of the 51-L crew had flown on the Space Shuttle before, and on which missions? How many were they, and which of them had already flown aboard the Orbiter Challenger itself?

The Hughes payload specialist joined the 51-L crew late. On what date, from which flight was he moved, and whose late addition to that flight made the move necessary? What did 51-L lose in exchange? One of 51-L's primary payloads and a satellite slot removed from 51-L were part of a single reshuffle caused by one customer: from which flight did that payload come, which satellite slot was removed, what had the customer asked for, and how many flights did the reshuffle affect?

Several departures from maintenance requirements during Challenger's preparation for 51-L are documented in different parts of the report. How many required Orbiter structural inspections were waived and out of how many, how many of these were repeat waivers, and how many of the required inspections were not waived? How many parts were taken from other Orbiters for Challenger, out of roughly how many required? How many further requirements did the 51-L audit find unmet and not formally waived, how many 'designated verifiers' did the Shuttle Processing Contractor use, and which recommendation of the Commission (number and title) addresses both the waived inspections and the parts removal?

The report discusses NASA safety panels in Chapter VII and in its Recommendations. For the Aerospace Safety Advisory Panel: after which event (give its date) was it established, and how many members may it have, how many of them from NASA? For the Space Shuttle Crew Safety Panel: how many members did it have in total, how often did it meet, what happened to it when its original chairman retired, and when did it end (the report gives two different years)? And which new panel devoted to the operational safety of Shuttle flights does the Commission recommend, reporting to whom?

On January 28, 1986, which sites did 51-L have for a transatlantic abort landing and for an abort once around? One transatlantic site was declared unavailable that morning: at what time and why, and why had the earlier afternoon launch window already ruled it out? Within what period after liftoff can a Shuttle that loses one main engine return to the launch site, what happens if two or three main engines fail early in ascent, and what concern had the Aerospace Safety Advisory Panel voiced about the primary transatlantic site?

A Commission member who was an astronaut chaired the Rogers Commission's Accident Analysis Panel and had herself flown two Shuttle missions aboard Discovery. Which missions were they, which panel did she actually chair, and what were the Commission's other investigative panels?

The range safety officer who sent the destruct commands on January 28, 1986, had also supplied the historical estimate of solid-rocket reliability that Feynman cites in Appendix F. What did that estimate find, and what failure rates does Feynman consider reasonable or attainable for mature solid rockets, and what follows for the Shuttle's pair of boosters?
What was the age of the teacher on the Challenger crew on the day of the Challenger accident?
How many reporters and journalists were accredited at the Kennedy Space Center for the STS-51-L launch?
At what temperature does the Viton rubber used in the Shuttle's O-rings undergo its glass transition?
What was the name of the NASA flight surgeon assigned to the STS-51-L crew?
Who was the NASA public affairs commentator who said 'obviously a major malfunction' after the explosion?
What was the relative humidity at the launch pad at the time of the STS-51-L liftoff?
How many square miles of ocean did the search for Challenger debris cover?
Which professional award did a Thiokol engineer who objected to the launch receive for his testimony to the Commission?
Who was the backup candidate for the Teacher in Space program who trained alongside the teacher on the crew?
How many pounds did the Challenger crew compartment weigh?

Wie lange werden gelöschte Objekte in Microsoft 365 der Bundesverwaltung im benutzerseitigen und im Administrator-Papierkorb vorgehalten, und wo wird die Administrationskonsole der Backup-Lösung gehostet?
On what date and at about what time did the unintended locomotive movement at Sheffield Park on the Bluebell Railway occur, which two locomotives were involved, and how far did they move?
Welche jährlichen Beiträge leistete der Bund der Wiener Zeitung GmbH laut WZEVI-Gesetz für ihre drei neuen gesetzlichen Aufgaben, und welche Summe ergab das?

Under the InnovFin financial instruments of Horizon 2020, what share of final recipients were SMEs, what share of all InnovFin financing did they receive (also in absolute terms), and which design feature excluded many smaller firms?
What propulsion and fuel arrangement did migrant boat 512 have: engine power, size of the connected fuel tank, fuel consumption, and spare fuel carried?

Wie viele Lehrstellen schrieb das Verteidigungsministerium in den Jahren 2020 bis 2025 aus, wie viele davon wurden besetzt, und welche Übernahmequote nach Abschluss der Lehre erreichten die überprüften Instandsetzungseinrichtungen im Vergleich zum Ziel?

Vergleiche für die Influenza-Saisonen 2023/24 und 2024/25 die Zahl der im Öffentlichen Impfprogramm gekauften und der ausgelieferten Impfdosen. In welcher Saison wurden mehr Dosen ausgeliefert als gekauft und warum, und worauf ging die Differenz in der anderen Saison zurück?

Wie hoch war die Überkompensation der beiden DAWI-Betrauungen der Wiener Zeitung GmbH (Medium und Media Hub) in den Jahren 2023 und 2024? Nenne für beide die Jahreswerte, die kumulierten Beträge mit ihrem Anteil an der Ausgleichsleistung und die Summe beider DAWI.

Wie entwickelten sich die geplanten Investitionskosten des Aufbauplans 2032+ über die drei Kalkulationsstände, für welchen Zeitraum galt der jüngste Stand, und um wie viel Prozent stiegen sie laut RH? Wie viel des ersten Werts war als Reserve vorgesehen, und welche Summe ergeben die drei Kernbereiche dieses ersten Werts ohne Reserve?

In welchen Jahren seit 2019 wies der Ausgleichstaxfonds laut Tabelle 6 einen negativen Saldo aus, in welcher Höhe jeweils? Auf welchen Wert würde sein Vermögen Ende 2025 sinken, und wie viel an Sonderdotierungen des Bundes plante das Sozialministerium für 2026 bis 2029 insgesamt?

In welchem Jahr war der Abstand zwischen der Beschäftigungsquote der begünstigten Behinderten und der Vergleichsgruppe am größten, und wie groß war er? In welchen Jahren lag die Arbeitslosenquote der begünstigten Behinderten unter jener der Vergleichsgruppe? Und wie viele arbeitslose begünstigte Behinderte zählten Statistik Austria und Arbeitsmarktservice im Jahr 2022? Um wie viel Prozent höher gibt der Bericht die eine Zahl an, und um wie viel Prozent liegt sie nach deiner eigenen Rechnung aus den beiden Zahlen darüber?

Wie viele Gebarungsfälle mit welchem Volumen überprüfte der RH in seiner risikoorientierten Auswahl, wie viele davon waren ausreichend dokumentiert, und wie teilen sich die übrigen mangelhaften Fälle auf (im Bericht detailliert dargestellt bzw. nur zusammengefasst, mit Volumen)?

Wie hoch war der Verpflichtungskredit für das Programm Erneuerung ZEMIS, wie viel betrug die zweite Tranche und – rechnerisch – die erste? Um wie viel kürzte der Bundesrat die Mittel im Entwicklungsrahmen 2027–2028 und an welchem Tag? Wie hoch sind die Reserven in der Kostenplanung von 2024, und welcher Mehrbedarf eines einzelnen Projekts stand ihnen zum Prüfungszeitpunkt gegenüber?

Vergleiche die beiden EFK-Prüfungen zu Microsoft 365 und zur Erneuerung ZEMIS: In welchem Zeitraum fand jeweils die Prüfung statt, wann die Schlussbesprechung, und wie viele neue Empfehlungen mit welcher Priorität sprach die EFK jeweils aus?
Wie viele Schlussempfehlungen enthält jeder der fünf Berichte des Rechnungshofs Österreich im Bestand? Welcher Bericht enthält die meisten, welcher die wenigsten, und wie viele sind es zusammen?

For the three ECA special reports in the collection (24/2026 on innovation and competitiveness, 25/2026 on marine protected areas, 29/2026 on RRF support for public administration): on what date was each adopted, which chamber (give its number) adopted each, which two were adopted by the same chamber, and how many numbered recommendations do the three reports contain in total?

How many marine special areas of conservation (Habitats Directive) and special protection areas (Birds Directive) are there, with their areas, and by how many sites and how many km² does their simple sum exceed the number and area of the marine Natura 2000 network?

Which four EU funding sources does the ECA identify as earmarked for marine biodiversity in the 2021-2027 period, with what amounts, and what is their exact sum (the report rounds it)? Within the EMFAF allocation for specific objective 1.6, how much goes to type 6 and type 1 interventions, and how much more has been allocated to type 6 under other objectives?

How many of the 2019-2020 public administration sub-CSRs did the Commission consider addressed by RRF measures, and how did the ECA's own assessment differ: how many sub-CSRs did the ECA assess and why not all, how many did it find addressed and to what degree, and for which member state did it conclude, at member-state level, that the sub-CSRs were not addressed at all?
facts: none of the sub-csrs are fully

questions.question: Across the four accident investigation reports in the collection (the NTSB report on Lake Erie, the two MAIB reports and the RAIB report), how many new safety recommendations are made in total, and to which organisations are they addressed, with how many each?
Warum ordnete der Chef des Generalstabs den Aufbauplan 2032+ bereits im August 2021 an?
Das Landwirtschaftsministerium ließ das Magazin „Landreport“ wie im Werkvertrag vorgesehen in acht Ausgaben mit je 20.000 Stück Auflage herstellen. Wie viel zahlte es dafür insgesamt?

Of the four member states the ECA visited on the spot for its special report on RRF support in public administration – Czechia, Germany, Greece and Italy – which achieved significant results for the largest share of its audited measures, and how many?
Warum waren die Kontingente des Impfstoffs gegen Pneumokokken im Gratis-Impfprogramm bis Ende März 2026 jeweils innerhalb von ein bis elf Tagen ausgeschöpft?

Die EFK hat in ihrer Prüfung zur Erneuerung ZEMIS auch frühere Empfehlungen nachgeprüft. Wie viele waren es, wie viele davon beurteilte sie als umgesetzt (mit Nummer) und wie viele als noch nicht umgesetzt? Welches ist die späteste Frist oder Nachfrist unter den nachgeprüften Empfehlungen? In welcher früheren Empfehlung will das SEM laut seiner Stellungnahme die neue Empfehlung 2 bearbeiten, welche Nachfrist galt für diese, und wie beurteilte die EFK ihren Stand?

For the three ECA special reports in the collection (24/2026, 25/2026 and 29/2026), what target implementation date did the ECA set for each recommendation? How many recommendations have their whole target date in 2027 (not counting split dates), which recommendation has a split target date and what are its parts, which date is the only one given to the quarter, and which recommendation has the latest target date and what does it ask the Commission to do?
facts: four recommendations have a target date in 2027
four have a target date in 2027
four are due by the end of 2027

questions.question: Der RH gibt in jedem seiner fünf Berichte im Bestand an, von wann bis wann er die Gebarungsüberprüfung durchführte (gemeint ist nicht der überprüfte Zeitraum). Nenne diesen Zeitraum für jeden der fünf Berichte. Wie viele Monate dauerte die längste dieser Überprüfungen, und wie viele Monate ergeben alle fünf zusammen, wenn Anfangs- und Endmonat jeweils mitgezählt werden? Welche der Berichte nennen ausdrücklich ein Nachhaltigkeitsziel der Vereinten Nationen, und welches?

Für die Jahre 2025 und 2026 wich die Finanzierung der Wiener Zeitung GmbH durch den Bund von den Beträgen des WZEVI-Gesetzes ab. Wie viel leistete der Bund in diesen beiden Jahren jährlich für das Medium Wiener Zeitung, für den Media Hub und für die elektronische Verlautbarungs- und Informationsplattform, welche Jahressumme ergibt das, und wie viel weniger erhält die Gesellschaft dadurch über beide Jahre zusammen? Woraus ist die Differenz auszugleichen, wie hoch waren die freien Gewinnrücklagen der Mediengruppe insgesamt, und welche Gesamtsumme der Bundesbeiträge hatte ein interner Gesetzesentwurf vom Sommer 2022 vorgesehen?
facts: 5 mio. eur für die wiener zeitung

questions.question: Why did the MAIB address its safety recommendation on the Arvia accident to Carnival UK Ltd, a different company from Arvia's registered owner and manager, Carnival plc?

Wie viele neue Empfehlungen sprechen die zehn Prüfberichte der drei Rechnungshöfe im Bestand aus – die fünf des österreichischen Rechnungshofs, die zwei der Eidgenössischen Finanzkontrolle und die drei Sonderberichte des Europäischen Rechnungshofs? Nenne die Zahl je Institution und die Gesamtzahl; bei der EFK zählen nur neue Empfehlungen, nicht nachgeprüfte frühere. Wie haben die geprüften Stellen in der Schweiz auf die neuen EFK-Empfehlungen reagiert?

Warum prüfte der Rechnungshof für seine Berichte zum Ausgleichstaxfonds und zum Gratis-Impfprogramm zwei verschiedene Bundesministerien, das Sozialministerium und das Gesundheitsministerium, und in welchem Monat nahm jedes der beiden Ministerien zum jeweiligen Prüfungsergebnis Stellung?
facts: arbeit, soziales, gesundheit, pflege und konsumentenschutz

questions.question: Laut RH-Bericht zur Umsetzbarkeit des Aufbauplans 2032+ erlaubt das Wehrgesetz, Wehrpflichtige auch ohne freiwillige Meldung zu Milizübungen zu verpflichten. Angenommen, in einem Kalenderjahr hätten sich 10 von Hundert der Wehrpflichtigen, die den Grundwehrdienst geleistet haben, freiwillig zu Milizübungen gemeldet: Wie viele von Hundert dieses Jahrgangs dürfte das Verteidigungsministerium dann höchstens noch zusätzlich verpflichten, und warum? Nutzte das Ministerium diese Möglichkeit?

Nach dem RH-Bericht zur Neuausrichtung der Wiener Zeitung GmbH hätte deren Tochtergesellschaft Aufträge nur dann vergaberechtsfrei als Inhouse-Vergabe erhalten können, wenn sie das Wesentlichkeitskriterium erfüllt. Welche Schwelle gilt dafür? In welchem Jahr von 2020 bis 2024 kam die Tochtergesellschaft dieser Schwelle mit ihrem Umsatzanteil aus Leistungen für die Wiener Zeitung GmbH am nächsten, mit welchem Anteil, und um wie viele Prozentpunkte lag sie selbst dann darunter?

Rule 33 of the Inland Navigation Rules exempts some vessels from carrying a whistle. In the NTSB report on the Lake Erie collision, did that exemption apply to the GLERL uncrewed surface vessel, judging by its overall length in metres? What did Rule 33 require of it instead, and did it comply? Would the Prestige 450 Flybridge have fallen under the same exemption?

In the RAIB report on Sheffield Park, the Bluebell Railway's October 2022 risk assessment for operating Fenchurch scored the hazard of staff being crushed or scalded. What score did it give before controls, and from which likelihood and severity scores? Under the railway's instruction GI028, did that score call for additional measures if it remained after existing controls, and by how many points did it exceed the relevant threshold? What residual risk did the assessment record after its control measure?

Im RH-Bericht zur Umsetzbarkeit des Aufbauplans 2032+ ermittelte die Direktion 4 Logistik zusätzlichen Lagerraumbedarf an Palettenplätzen. Wie viele Palettenplätze Zusatzbedarf ergeben ihre beiden Angaben zusammen, wie viele davon blieben selbst nach Inbetriebnahme des Lagerprojekts mit dem frühesten geplanten Fertigstellungstermin offen, und wie viele Palettenplätze fehlten danach noch bis zu der Gesamtkapazität, die die Direktion 4 Logistik für die Verdoppelung der Lagerkapazität nannte? Wann sollten laut dem Zeitplan vom Jänner 2023 die Einlagerungen beginnen, und wann war die Inbetriebnahme dieses Projekts vorgesehen?

Laut RH-Bericht zum Ausgleichstaxfonds legte das Sozialministerium die Höhe des jährlichen Mobilitätszuschusses für Menschen mit Behinderungen jedes Jahr neu fest. Wie hoch war der Zuschuss im Jahr 2022, rechnerisch aus den Angaben des Berichts hergeleitet? Um wie viel EUR und um wie viel Prozent wurde er im Juli 2025 gegenüber 2024 gekürzt, und um wie viel EUR lag er danach unter dem Betrag von 2022?

In which member states did the ECA carry out visits or close examinations for each of its three special reports in the collection (24/2026 on innovation and competitiveness, 25/2026 on marine protected areas, 29/2026 on RRF support for public administration)? Which member state appears for more than one of these reports, how many member-state visits are there in total, and how many different member states were visited?
facts: spain appears in more than one

questions.question: Which of the four accident investigation reports in the collection (the NTSB report on the Lake Erie collision, the MAIB report on Arvia, the MAIB report on migrant boat 512 and the RAIB report on Sheffield Park) state the air temperature at the time of the accident? Converted to degrees Celsius, which accident had the warmest air, and by how much was it warmer than the second warmest? How many degrees Celsius separate the warmest and the coolest of the stated air temperatures?
